title: Form EIA-860 Early Release: 2025 Generator Inventory
summary: EIA's early-release 2025 Form 860 files provide generator-level records for operable, proposed, retired, canceled, and postponed units, with an explicit preliminary-release boundary.
key_findings: The release separates existing, proposed, retired, canceled, and postponed generator records rather than treating them as one capacity total.
Fields support technology, capacity, status, ownership, location, and planned-date analysis at generator level.
EIA identifies the release as early data that can be revised before the final annual publication.
why_it_matters: Form 860 gives FTFN a consistent inventory rail for testing power-capacity claims while preserving generator status and release vintage.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a current generator inventory to the Energy pathway.
Supports bounded Arizona and utility-area capacity queries.
Separates proposed and canceled capacity from operable capacity.
evidence_limits: A proposed generator record is not a construction commitment or operating asset.
Early-release values are preliminary and may be revised.
Generator inventory alone does not prove transmission deliverability, local interconnection, customer service, reliability, or price.
